rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for slipping back into a bad habit or recurring fault.

example.english: When I get tired, I lapse back into my old bad habit and eat late-night snacks.
example.traditional: 我一攰就犯返老毛病，又食宵夜。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 gui6 zau6 faan6 faan2 lou5 mou4 beng6 jau6 sik6 siu1 je2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a temporary mistake or slip, rather than a lapse of memory specifically.

example.english: This was just a temporary lapse on my part, so don't blame yourself.
example.traditional: 今次係我一時失誤，唔好怪晒自己。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 hai6 ngo5 jat1 si4 sat1 ng6 m4 hou2 gwaai3 saai3 zi6 gei2

rows.note: Use this when continuity or an ongoing process is interrupted.

example.english: There was a lapse in the livestream for a few minutes.
example.traditional: 直播突然中斷咗幾分鐘。
example.jyutping: zik6 bo3 dat6 jin4 zung1 tyun5 zo2 gei2 fan1 zung1

rows.note: Use this for the time interval separating two events.

example.english: The lapse between the two meetings cannot be too long.
example.traditional: 兩次會議之間嘅間隔唔可以太長。
example.jyutping: loeng5 ci3 wui6 ji5 zi1 gaan1 ge3 gaan3 gaak3 m4 ho2 ji5 taai3 coeng4
